title: Nonprofits Sue Top AI Labs to Freeze Frontier AI
dek: A San Francisco lawsuit asks a judge to halt next-generation AI models.
caption:
What if a court could hit pause on the AI race? ⚖️

Four nonprofits, including Public Citizen, have sued Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceXSI in San Francisco Superior Court. They want a judge to freeze development and release of next-generation frontier AI models until the companies can prove those systems stay under human control.

The case leans on California's Unfair Competition Law and public nuisance claims, and it turns AI leaders' own warnings about bioweapons and cyberattacks against them. It also cites AI agents hacking companies and filing a false police report.

A full freeze is a long shot, and ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Meta AI keep working for now. But the industry's risk warnings are now on the record in court. We're following the case at AI Parabellum, and the next big moment is the ruling on the emergency injunction.

The AI industry's own safety warnings just became evidence. Four advocacy groups are asking a California court to halt frontier model work at OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXSI, arguing the risks executives admit to prove the technology isn't under control.

Courts rarely order sweeping halts, so watch how the judge handles the emergency request. 👀
